name: @puregamma/harness
description: PureGamma Harness — AI-native investment research and execution workspace on DeepSeek Harness

scripts.build:host: pnpm --filter @puregamma/dsh-auth run bundle && pnpm --filter @puregamma/dsh-billing run bundle && pnpm --filter @puregamma/dsh-notifications run bundle && pnpm --filter @puregamma/dsh-pg-tsy-runtime run bundle && tsc -b tsconfig.host.json && tsdown --config tsdown.host.ts --env.DSH_BUILD_FACE host
